issuers.notes: Listing read at https://www.axis.bank.in/cards/credit-card (about 40 cards named) plus the Axis Key Fact Sheet PDF https://www.axis.bank.in/docs/default-source/default-document-library/credit-card/sosc-credit-cards.pdf ('last updated on 8th October 2026'; names retail, partnership, affluent, legacy and secured cards) and the Citi transition page https://www.axis.bank.in/forward-together/migrate-credit-cards (15 July 2024). Former Citi cards now serviced by Axis: Citi Rewards and CitiBusiness -> REWARDS (live); IndianOil Citi / CitiBusiness -> IndianOil Premium (live); PremierMiles -> HORIZON (live); Prestige -> OLYMPUS (missing); Cash Back -> CASHBACK (live); First Citizen -> Shoppers Stop (draft); IKEA Family -> IKEA Family Credit Card by Axis Bank (missing). ACCESS: after a burst of parallel downloads the Axis site returned 403 'Access Denied' to curl for the Magnus, Kwik, base Vistara product pages, two Citi transition pages (cashback, rewards), commercial cards page, NRI page and the KFS PDF; the built-in browser pane was also refused. No User-Agent or cookie changes were made. The fetch tool (WebFetch) was not refused for the base Vistara page, the commercial cards menu and the KFS PDF, so those were read through it; the NRI page (https://www.axis.bank.in/nri/nri-credit-card) was refused there too and was NOT read, so NRI-specific Axis cards are unchecked. The Magnus and Kwik pages were not read (both already held: Magnus live, Kwik draft). Closed or ending but still live in catalogue (not stale): Samsung Axis Bank Infinite page says 'We are currently not accepting applications for SAMSUNG AXIS BANK INFINITE Credit Card' (use Samsung Signature); Vistara Signature and Vistara Infinite pages say 'The Axis Bank Vistara Credit Card will be discontinued for spends post 15 December 2026 following the merger of Vistara with Air India'; Axis Select page says it is complimentary exclusively for Burgundy customers. Axis Bank Freecharge and Freecharge Plus share one invite-only statement. Legacy and secured rows come only from the Key Fact Sheet tables and have no product page; treat as low priority. Axis Bank Rewards page mentions 'Lifetime free and migrated card' variants of the same product. offered_count = live matched + non-live drafts + missing (stale_live excluded); of the 37 missing, 15 are retail/partner/affluent rows and 22 are legacy, secured or commercial rows.
